truth_rules: Public documentation must distinguish documented, preview, older, PLANNED, COMING_SOON and NOT_VERIFIED.
Unknown or not-verified behavior must not be advertised as documented.
Built-in components must come from the audited built-in component index.
Tenant-specific Custom or Published components must not be described as official built-ins.
Credential values and private implementation source must never be exported into public documentation.
